# Team-local agents (Ring 3)

Your team's own agents live here as `<name>.agent.md`. The template **never overwrites this directory**.

- Match the shape of the agents in `.github/agents/` (frontmatter `name`, `description`, `tools`).
- Run it from the **agents dropdown** at the bottom of Copilot Chat (Agent mode), then type your task —
  the same way you run any agent in VS Code or Rider. (You do *not* type `@<name>`; that only works in
  Visual Studio.)
- Trial for a sprint or two. If the agent proves useful to other teams, **propose it upstream** to
  `ai-sdlc-template` — that's how a local idea becomes a versioned, fanned-out standard without forking.
